word\/document.xml: Austen’s preoccupation with order and control stems, to a large extent, from the fact that, at the time she wrote, the aristocratic stronghold which she strongly supported was being threatened, both socially and politically, by powerful forces of change.

Забота Джейн Остин о порядке и контроле в значительной степени связана с тем, что в то время, когда она писала, аристократической крепости, которую она решительно поддерживала, угрожали, как в социальном, так и в политическом плане, могущественные силы перемен.

Austen’s preoccupation with order and control stems, to a large extent, from the fact that, at the time she wrote, the aristocratic stronghold which she strongly supported was being threatened, both socially and politically, by powerful forces of change.
word/document.xml
Austen was born in 1775 to a clergyman in Stevenson in Hertfordshire and staunchly upheld the conservative values of the upper-middle class into which the was born.
В начале было слово. И этого, в общем, вполне достаточно.
Austen was born in 1775 to a clergyman in Stevenson in Hertfordshire and staunchly upheld the conservative values of the upper-middle class into which the was born.
word/document.xml
This class consisted of the landowners or the 'gentry' who possessed most of the wealth in an England which was still predominantly an agricultural society.
This class consisted of the landowners or the 'gentry' who possessed most of the wealth in an England which was still predominantly an agricultural society.

The aristocracy maintained social order at this time, not by use of a police force, but through reliance on the army and a system of deferential respect, which, at best could be described as one of solidarity and regard, at worst one of intimidation and punishment.

В то время аристократия поддерживала общественный порядок не с помощью полиции, а опираясь на армию и систему почтительного уважения, которую в лучшем случае можно было бы охарактеризовать как систему солидарности и уважения, а в худшем — как систему запугивания и наказания.

The aristocracy maintained social order at this time, not by use of a police force, but through reliance on the army and a system of deferential respect, which, at best could be described as one of solidarity and regard, at worst one of intimidation and punishment.

It most certainly had the potential for selfishness, snobbery and insincerity.

The French Revolution had brought defeat to the French monarchy in 1789 and this turn of events generated insecurity and fear that the revolutionary fervor would spread to England.
Французская революция привела к падению французской монархии в 1789 году, и этот поворот событий породил неуверенность и опасения, что революционный пыл распространится на Англию.
The French Revolution had brought defeat to the French monarchy in 1789 and this turn of events generated insecurity and fear that the revolutionary fervor would spread to England.

At first glance, nothing of these revolutionary events intrudes into Austen's novels and she is often criticized for her refusal to confront the serious issues of her time.
На первый взгляд, ни одно из этих революционных событий не проникает в романы Остин, и ее часто критикуют за отказ от рассмотрения серьезных проблем своего времени.
At first glance, nothing of these revolutionary events intrudes into Austen's novels and she is often criticized for her refusal to confront the serious issues of her time.

Her focus remains on county courtship rituals and only indirectly are political issues significant.
